## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] CI quality-gate passed (types, unit/component/integration, database, browser, audit).
- [ ] QA deployment uses the QA database; relevant user flows checked.
- [ ] Migrations applied to QA; production order documented if applicable.
- [ ] No production secrets, customer data or generated test reports in the diff.

## Release / rollback

Note migrations, environment changes and rollback steps, or write “none”.
